title: The Red, the Black, and the Green

sentences.en: This is a rebroadcast of an episode reported a few years ago by Christopher Johnson.
sentences.zh: 这是一期重播节目，由克里斯托弗·约翰逊几年前进行报道。

sentences.en: It's everything I love in a story.
sentences.zh: 这包含了所有我喜欢的故事元素。

sentences.en: So if you haven't heard it before, definitely listen to it.
sentences.zh: 所以如果你以前没听过，绝对应该听一听。

sentences.en: And if you have listened to it before, listen again, because I guarantee you don't remember the details.
sentences.zh: 如果你以前听过，再听一遍吧，因为我保证你已经记不清细节了。

sentences.en: But if you want to hear a completely brand new episode of 99% Invisible about lifeboats on the Titanic,
sentences.zh: 但如果你想听一期全新的关于泰坦尼克号救生艇的“99%隐形”节目，

sentences.en: A quick heads up, this episode has some offensive language.
sentences.zh: 温馨提示，本集包含一些攻击性语言。

sentences.en: After Minneapolis police officer Derek Chauvin murdered George Floyd last year,
sentences.zh: 去年，明尼阿波利斯警官德里克·肖万谋杀乔治·弗洛伊德之后，

sentences.en: tens of thousands of people all over the world took to the streets
sentences.zh: 世界各地的成千上万人走上街头，

sentences.en: to protest police violence against Black people.
sentences.zh: 抗议警察针对黑人的暴力行为。

sentences.en: And if you look at images from these marches, you'll probably start to notice a common color scheme.
sentences.zh: 如果你看看这些游行的画面，你可能会开始注意到一种共同的配色方案。

sentences.en: Lots of red, black, and green.

sentences.zh: 99BI 制作人克里斯托弗·约翰逊。
你到处都能看到这些颜色。

sentences.en: Red, black, and green picket signs and banners.
sentences.zh: 红、黑、绿相间的标语牌和横幅。

sentences.en: Red, black, and green hoodies and hats.
sentences.zh: 红、黑、绿相间的连帽衫和帽子。

sentences.en: And red, black, and green flags.
sentences.zh: 还有红、黑、绿色相间的旗帜。

sentences.en: Sometimes it's good to see that red, black, and green flag, particularly when there's times of strife
sentences.zh: 有时看到那面红、黑、绿相间的旗帜感觉很好，特别是在发生冲突的时候，

sentences.en: and people are outraged and angry.
sentences.zh: 人们感到愤怒和激愤时。

sentences.en: And they start to come to that realization that we're not getting anywhere with the begging.
sentences.zh: 他们开始意识到，通过乞求我们什么也得不到。

sentences.en: Moria Makumal has several of these flags in different sizes,
sentences.zh: 莫里亚·马库马尔有几面这样大小不一的旗帜，

sentences.en: including a huge one that he likes to fly outside of his house.
sentences.zh: 其中包括一面他喜欢挂在房前的大旗。

sentences.en: He says that wherever there are protests or demonstrations against threats to Black life,
sentences.zh: 他说，无论哪里有针对黑人生存威胁的抗议或示威活动，

sentences.en: the red, black, and green will be there.
sentences.zh: 红、黑、绿三色就会出现在那里。

sentences.en: When people are ready for more than what they've been getting,
sentences.zh: 当人们准备好争取比以往更多的东西时，

sentences.en: and they're ready to, you know, challenge the system,
sentences.zh: 当他们准备好，你知道的，去挑战体制时，

sentences.en: then you'll see the red, black, and green flags come out.
sentences.zh: 你就会看到红、黑、绿相间的旗帜出现。
而且不仅仅是在示威活动中。

sentences.en: This tricolor scheme has been used on t-shirts, on high-top chucks,
sentences.zh: 这种三色方案已被用于 T 恤、高帮帆布鞋，

sentences.en: and in works of art that have sold for millions of dollars.
sentences.zh: 以及售价数百万美元的艺术品中。

sentences.en: The flag was invented to unite Black people all over the world
sentences.zh: 这面旗帜的发明是为了团结世界各地

sentences.en: who were living under racial repression.
sentences.zh: 生活在种族压迫下的黑人。

sentences.en: And when it first came into existence,
the flag posed some bold questions about where Black people owed their loyalty,
sentences.zh: 这面旗帜提出了一个关于黑人效忠对象的大胆问题：

sentences.en: to the nations where their lives were demeaned and threatened,
sentences.zh: 是效忠于那些贬低和威胁他们生命的国家，

sentences.en: or to a new nation, one they'd build entirely for themselves.
sentences.zh: 还是效忠于一个全新的、完全为自己建立的国家？

sentences.en: And for hundreds of thousands of Black folks,
sentences.zh: 对于数十万黑人同胞来说，

sentences.en: the red, black, and green symbolized the answer.
sentences.zh: 红色、黑色和绿色象征着答案。

sentences.en: The flag has been in use since 1918,
sentences.zh: 这面旗帜自 1918 年起就开始使用，

sentences.en: but I'm going to start a couple decades before that
sentences.zh: 但我打算从那之前几十年开始讲起，

sentences.en: with the story of a super-racist song about flags.
sentences.zh: 讲一个关于旗帜的超级种族主义歌曲的故事。

sentences.en: In the beginning of the 20th century,
there was vaudeville, there was minstrelsy in America,
sentences.zh: 美国有杂耍表演，有吟游艺人表演，

sentences.en: and there was this tradition of coon songs.
sentences.zh: 还有这种黑人谐趣歌曲的传统。

sentences.en: Can I say that word, Christopher?
sentences.zh: 我能说出那个词吗，克里斯托弗？

sentences.en: This is writer and historian Colin Grant.
sentences.zh: 这位是作家兼历史学家科林·格兰特。

sentences.en: He's talking about an old style of American music
sentences.zh: 他谈论的是一种以种族贬义词命名的

sentences.en: that's named after a racial slur.
Coon songs were exactly what they sound like.
sentences.zh: 黑人谐趣歌曲正如其名。

sentences.en: based on gross stereotypes about Black life and speech patterns,
sentences.zh: 基于对黑人生活和言语模式的粗俗刻板印象，
通常伴随着拉格泰姆钢琴曲调演唱。

sentences.en: And in 1900, one of the biggest songs of the genre came out.
sentences.zh: 在 1900 年，该流派最热门的歌曲之一问世了。

sentences.en: There was a very famous coon song called
sentences.zh: 有一首非常著名的黑人谐趣歌曲叫作

sentences.en: Every Race Has a Flag But the Coon.
sentences.zh: 《每种人都有旗帜，唯独黑鬼没有》。

sentences.en: And it was a song that lampooned Black people
for not having their own flag,
and lampooned them for the idea that they should have their own flag.
sentences.zh: 并嘲讽他们想要拥有自己旗帜的想法。

sentences.en: Two white composers wrote the song,
sentences.zh: 两个白人作曲家写了这首歌，

sentences.en: and I got somebody to play the sheet music for me.
sentences.zh: 我找人给我弹奏了这首乐谱。

sentences.en: In the lyrics, the head of a Black social club gets up to speak.
sentences.zh: 在歌词中，一个黑人社交俱乐部的负责人起身发言。

sentences.en: And he says he's just come back from a Labor Day parade
sentences.zh: 他说他刚刚从一个劳动节游行回来，

sentences.en: where he saw all these different races
sentences.zh: 在那里他看到了所有这些不同的种族
骄傲地挥舞着他们的国旗。

sentences.en: Ireland has her harp and shamrock,
sentences.zh: 爱尔兰有竖琴和三叶草，
英格兰高扬威武的雄狮，
甚至连中国也挥舞着龙旗，

sentences.en: And then he comes to the U.S.
for the old red, white, and blue?
sentences.zh: 红、白、蓝旧国旗，又会做出什么事呢？

sentences.en: The lyrics seem to drive at the idea
sentences.zh: 歌词似乎在暗示这样一个观点：

sentences.en: that the Stars and Stripes didn't belong to Black people,
that they'd need something else to represent them.
sentences.zh: 他们需要别的东西来代表自己。

sentences.en: The song went on to propose a flag for Black people
sentences.zh: 这首歌接着为黑人设计了一面旗帜，

sentences.en: that's crammed with all these racist stereotypes.
sentences.zh: 里面塞满了各种种族主义刻板印象。

sentences.en: Every Race Has a Flag was performed by more than 100 touring vaudeville acts
sentences.zh: 《每个种族都有国旗》这首歌曾在100多个巡回杂耍演出中表演过，

sentences.en: and was part of the vaudeville circuit for more than three decades.
sentences.zh: 并且在杂耍演出界活跃了三十多年。

sentences.en: It was huge, which isn't surprising given the era.
sentences.zh: 它非常火爆，考虑到那个时代，这并不令人意外。

sentences.en: wasn't even two generations out of slavery.
sentences.zh: 甚至还没摆脱奴隶制两代人的时间。

sentences.en: Jim Crow and Separate But Equal were in full effect.
sentences.zh: 吉姆·克劳法和“隔离但平等”政策全面生效。

sentences.en: Lynching and other terrorist violence surged.
sentences.zh: 林奇和其他恐怖暴力事件激增。

sentences.en: Black Americans were getting the message from all sides,
sentences.zh: 美国黑人从各个方面接收到一个信息，

sentences.en: that they weren't respected or safe
sentences.zh: 那就是他们不受尊重，缺乏安全感，

sentences.en: or really even considered fully American.
sentences.zh: 甚至根本不被当作真正的美国人。

sentences.en: Now, as gross as the song was,
sentences.zh: 话虽如此，尽管这首歌极其粗俗，

sentences.en: the lyrics hinted at something that did resonate for Black folks.
sentences.zh: 但歌词却触及了某些确实能引发黑人群体共鸣的东西。

sentences.en: That idea was one which many Black people understood.
sentences.zh: 许多黑人都理解这个想法。

sentences.zh: 他也很好奇，像他这样的黑人
